subject.title: Runtime Self Context: give agents runtime, scale, offload, and cost awareness

question: Should OpenClaw accept a core runtimeContext config plus model-facing runtime tool as the v1 runtime self-awareness contract, narrow that contract before merge, or defer the design to plugin/provider extension work?
rationale: The requested surface changes core config, prompt exposure, tool policy, session/context state, and provider/plugin ownership, so source inspection cannot choose the intended product/API boundary without maintainer direction.

options.title: Approve a narrow v1 core contract
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90101 as the first non-mutating config/tool slice if maintainers accept the core surface, and track provider refresh, action execution, and precise cost estimation separately.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Limit the first slice to the smallest prompt/tool or environment-adapter contract maintainers are comfortable supporting, leaving speculative fields out until provider hooks are designed.

options.title: Defer to plugin/API design
options.body: Keep this issue open as a design tracker and require a plugin/provider hook proposal before adding new core config or model-facing tool surface.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow v1 core contract
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90101 as the first non-mutating config/tool slice if maintainers accept the core surface, and track provider refresh, action execution, and precise cost estimation separately.
